# <package> <versionCode> <SHA-256 of the APK>   # kind
# Editor, Currency and Puzzles are in the other runtime's own e2e set (tests/e2e/apps.json) with the same pins.
# F-Droid has no app bundles, so no bundle install is compared.

# list or the workflow runs it on that branch, with the inputs' defaults.
